interview.name: Eli
interview.answer: The notes don’t say when or where the repair drive is being held.

reflections: Sam is cooperative and eager to take on concrete support tasks.
Eli is coordinating the repair drive and relies on others for logistics and tracking.
Pia is handling scheduling details and asks others to be flexible while she confirms the time.
Sam and Eli have a cooperative, task-focused relationship built around practical coordination.
Eli is responsive and patient when details are still pending, especially about timing and materials.
Mara and Pia are acting as organizers who provide updates and keep the group aligned on next steps.
Eli is generally cooperative and keeps his tools ready while waiting for details.
Mara is responsive and helpful, quickly promising to send logistics and updates to Eli.
Mina and Nell both need more information, and Eli is acting as the person who will relay updates once he has them.
Eli is coordinating a repair-drive plan and consistently asks for the confirmed time, location, and what tools to bring.
Mina, Nell, and Tess are each partially informed and act as information relays, with a shared norm of passing along updates as they learn them.
Faye appears the most certain participant, offering a specific time and place and signaling willingness to help set up.
Eli is organized but needs clear logistics before committing to attend or plan his day.
Faye, Sam, and Ira are all trying to keep Eli informed, but the event details are still shifting and partially unconfirmed.
Tess is helpful but cautious, sharing tentative information and offering to help once details are confirmed.

events.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Eli. What do you need me to do?
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. I’d like you to help sort donations and keep a simple list of what comes in, then we can see what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Sam: Absolutely—I can sort the donations and keep a simple list of everything that comes in.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—what time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: I’m still checking the time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it. If you can, just bring any tools you already have and a little patience.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: No problem—I’ll keep my tools handy and wait for your update.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — I’ll send you the list and the time right away.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Eli: That works for me, Mara. I’ll keep my tools handy and wait for your update.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Mara: Great, Eli — I’ll send the details soon, and thanks for keeping your tools ready.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Mina: Do you know where the repair drive is being held?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Eli: I’m not sure yet, Mina—I’m still waiting on the exact location. Once I know, I’ll let you know, and I can bring any tools I already have.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Eli. If you hear where the repair drive’s being held, let me know right away.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Eli: What time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m not sure yet — maybe we should check the sign-up or ask at the check-in table. If I hear anything more, I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Eli: That sounds good, Nell. I’ll check the sign-up or the check-in table and keep my tools handy.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 by the garage works for me. I’ll plan around the school schedule and be there.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Faye: Great — I’ll be there Saturday at 10 by your garage. Let me know if you want me to bring anything or help set up.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Eli: What time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard it’s getting a good turnout, but I still don’t have the exact time or location confirmed yet. If I hear more, I’ll pass it along—and if you need a tool, I’ll keep an eye out for that too.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Please let me know as soon as you have the time and location, and I’ll plan around it.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: I still need the time and a quick list of what to bring before I can plan my day.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Sam: Sure — I’ll send you the time and a quick bring-list right away.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll wait for the time and the bring-list, then I can set my day.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Ira: Yep — I heard it moved to the community center on Sunday, so I’m telling folks as I’m out running errands.
events.speaker: Ira

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Eli: Thanks for letting me know. What time on Sunday, and is there anything specific I should bring?
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Ira: I’m not sure on the time yet, but I’ll ask around. If you can, bring any tools you already have and maybe some gloves.
events.speaker: Ira

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
